question: Let $\vec{a}=3\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+4\hat{k}$, $\vec{b}=-\hat{i}+5\hat{j}-2\hat{k}$ and $\vec{r}=6\hat{i}+\hat{j}+7\hat{k}$. A vector $\vec{c}$ is such that $\vec{a}+\vec{b}+\vec{c}=\vec{r}$.(a) Determine $\vec{c}$.(b) Evaluate $(\vec{a}+\vec{b})+\vec{c}$ and $\vec{a}+(\vec{b}+\vec{c})$ separately.(c) Hence verify the associative property of vector addition for these vectors.
explanation: (a)From the given relation,`\vec{c}=\vec{r}-(\vec{a}+\vec{b})`First,`\vec{a}+\vec{b}=(3-1)\hat{i}+(-2+5)\hat{j}+(4-2)\hat{k}\vec{a}+\vec{b}=2\hat{i}+3\hat{j}+2\hat{k}`Therefore,`\vec{c}=(6-2)\hat{i}+(1-3)\hat{j}+(7-2)\hat{k}\vec{c}=4\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+5\hat{k}`(b)Using $\vec{a}+\vec{b}=2\hat{i}+3\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$,`\left(\vec{a}+\vec{b}\right)+\vec{c}=(2+4)\hat{i}+(3-2)\hat{j}+(2+5)\hat{k}\left(\vec{a}+\vec{b}\right)+\vec{c}=6\hat{i}+\hat{j}+7\hat{k}`Also,`\vec{b}+\vec{c}=(-1+4)\hat{i}+(5-2)\hat{j}+(-2+5)\hat{k}\vec{b}+\vec{c}=3\hat{i}+3\hat{j}+3\hat{k}`Therefore,`\vec{a}+\left(\vec{b}+\vec{c}\right)=(3+3)\hat{i}+(-2+3)\hat{j}+(4+3)\hat{k}\vec{a}+\left(\vec{b}+\vec{c}\right)=6\hat{i}+\hat{j}+7\hat{k}`(c)Since`\left(\vec{a}+\vec{b}\right)+\vec{c}=\vec{a}+\left(\vec{b}+\vec{c}\right)=6\hat{i}+\hat{j}+7\hat{k}`the associative property of vector addition is verified.

options.A:
(a) $\vec{c}=4\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+5\hat{k}$
(b) $(\vec{a}+\vec{b})+\vec{c}=\vec{a}+(\vec{b}+\vec{c})=6\hat{i}+\hat{j}+7\hat{k}$
(c) The associative property of vector addition is verified.
options.B:
(a) $\vec{c}=4\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+5\hat{k}$
(b) Both groupings equal $6\hat{i}+5\hat{j}+7\hat{k}$
(c) The associative property is verified.
options.C:
(a) $\vec{c}=-4\hat{i}+2\hat{j}-5\hat{k}$
(b) The two groupings give opposite vectors.
(c) The associative property is not verified.
options.D:
(a) $\vec{c}=2\hat{i}-3\hat{j}+5\hat{k}$
(b) Both groupings equal $4\hat{i}+7\hat{k}$
(c) The associative property is verified.
